seoDescription: Explore Casa Rustica room by room: the sunny garden, cosy living room, bright kitchen, four bedrooms and bathrooms.
title: Take a look around
description: Wander through the house and garden, room by room. Tap any photo to see it full screen.
outsideDescription: A white villa with a red-tiled roof, a sunny lawn and a covered terrace.
livingDescription: The heart of the house: checkered floors, a long family table and a bright kitchen.
bedroomsDescription: Four bedrooms, each with its own colour and character, for up to ten guests.
bathroomsDescription: A bathroom with a bathtub and skylight, two showers and plenty of charming corners.
